title: iDescriptor: free iMazing alternative
caption:
iMazing charges $49.99/year. iDescriptor manages your iPhone from a computer for free 📱

✅ Browse your iPhone albums and photos on your computer
✅ Battery health + a genuine-cable check
✅ Cast your iPhone screen to your computer
✅ No subscription, no tracking, 100% free

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ The Mac app isn't signed by Apple, so it needs one Terminal command on first launch (steps are in the README).

Comment "IPHONE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
